name: Fritz Linhardt
original_name: フリッツ・リンハルト
source:
Matthias's primary physician and childhood friend, he's a friendly young man who serves as Matthias's partner.

A genius doctor who consistently ranked at the top of his class during his student days.

His glasses are purely for fashion.

[Translated from [url=https://note.com/yuumint/n/n4d4183584098]official profile[/url]]
